generator.method: scripted Blender build, no image-to-3D: scripts/art/lamp/build_agent.bpy (Blender 5.2.2 arm64, bpy, headless)
generator.reference: the picked concept option H-s41 and the turnaround in options/, matched by eye in evidence/target-compare.jpg against reference/target-crop.png
generator.why_not_trellis: The figure is about 15 rounded primitives (a hood cup, an orb, a cone, capsules, balls, wire loops). The 2026-10-21 TRELLIS.2 run of the old lamp needed 3 seeds (two lost or split the arm), left 26 open edges and a ragged per-face glow edge, and its texture was thrown away; thin arms and a 1 mm wire loop are what image-to-3D fuses or drops. A script gives exact rigid parts per bone, a clean separate emissive orb and a unique UV for the AO bake. TRELLIS.2 was therefore not run for this build (research r1, r2 and r5 of 2026-10-24 expect the same).

tris_note: 8086 against 15000 (static working pose; the rigged final.fbx carries the same 8086)
materials: agent_shell: white clear-coat plastic (head hood outside, body cone, arm capsules); base colour 0.80/0.79/0.77 linear, roughness 0.35, clear coat 1.0 at roughness 0.08 (r4: albedo about 0.8, a second specular lobe)

agent_hood_inner: the inside of the hood; the shell white at roughness 0.45 plus a faint warm self-glow (#FFC48A x0.5) standing in for the orb bounce; UE: GlowStrength x 0.15 so it follows the agent state
agent_joint: dark metal shoulder, elbow and wrist balls, neck collar and wire loops; #3A3D42, roughness 0.38, metal 1
agent_glow: amber emissive orb in the hood, the front slit and the pin; #FFA94D x3 (UE drives GlowStrength per state)
agent_glow_card: the additive card in the hood opening, textures/agent_glow_card.png (radial falloff, white on black) tinted by the glow colour; UE: unlit additive, two-sided, no depth write
textures: textures/agent_basecolor.png, textures/agent_glow_card.png, textures/agent_orm.png: agent_basecolor.png (diffuse colour bake, sRGB) and agent_orm.png (R ambient occlusion, G roughness, B metal; linear), 1024 px, baked with Cycles on the CPU at 64 samples in 21.5 s (AO mean 0.451, self-occlusion only: hood over orb and collar, joints into capsules). No normal map: the shapes are real geometry with smooth shading. agent_glow_card.png 256 px. UE: BaseColor x lerp(1, AO, 0.6), because the forward path's SSAO is weak and there is no reflection capture (r4); the Blender materials of final.fbx are wired that way.

bounds_cm.note: final_working.glb in Blender axes (x width, y depth with the figure facing -y, z up), WORKING pose: the right arm hangs below the pin tip and the left arm reaches 26 cm out to +x, so the box is not centred; rest pose height pin tip to hood top 25.39 cm

lamp-agent.note: 18 rigid parts plus the glow card (a single quad, whose 4 boundary edges are the open edges)

pivot: the tip of the pin under the body (rest pose z = 0), on the body axis (x = y = 0); the figure hovers, so placement sets the pivot height above the table
axes: Blender Z up, the figure faces -Y (the hood opening looks -Y and 30 degrees down). glTF (final_working.glb) is Y-up with the figure facing +Z; UE Interchange turns either into Z-up with the figure facing UE +Y (as the old lamp-agent FBX landed: Blender -Y onto UE +Y). Yaw it 90 degrees less than "facing +X" needs; check one frame.

rig.weights: rigid: every vertex weight 1.0 to the one bone of its part (one rigid part per bone)
rig.contract_change: The 2026-10-21 contract was base > lower_arm > upper_arm > head (one arm, a desk lamp). The target character has two arms, so the contract is now body > head, body > arm_l_upper > arm_l_lower, body > arm_r_upper > arm_r_lower; arm_l is the figure's left (+X, the viewer's right). The UE AnimBP aims the head bone, as before.

placement.ue_choice: place final_working.glb as a STATIC mesh (5 sections = 5 draws, no skinning) for the capture; keep final.fbx (skeletal, 6 bones, 4 actions) for L5.7 states. The old SK_LampAgent placement drew 6 sections.
placement.where: hovering above the far edge of the table, centred a little left of the table centre, the pivot (pin tip) about 18 to 25 cm above the table plane, the hood facing the player (a yaw so the figure's -Y looks at the camera); in the 1600 x 900 target capture the head sits in the upper third, at about 46 % of the width, the hood about 8 % of the frame width across (the target crop: 1376 x 768 frame, hood centre at x = 645, y = 55, hood about 105 px wide)
placement.light: a warm point light inside the hood, just in front of the orb (build.json orb_centre_rest_m + 4.5 cm along open_axis, carried by the head bone), about #FFA85A, small source radius, short attenuation (about 40 cm) so it lights the hood inside, the body top and the arms, plus the card; and a faint cool rim from behind so the white silhouette separates from the dark room (r5: the old lamp dissolved into the background)
